choices.why: No mustard velvet sofa is in the catalog, so this warm cognac sofa is the closest in tone; it is leather, not velvet, and at 193 cm it fits the long right wall facing the balcony.
A natural rattan tub armchair is the classic bohemian rattan seat and suits the oak parquet.
It is the only rug large enough (335x239 cm) to sit under both the sofa and the armchair, and its deep blue and rust pattern brings the color the user asked for.
The teal, mustard and blush geometric print adds the requested mustard and ties the cognac sofa to the blue rug; three cushions cover the sofa and the armchair.
Leafy, easy-care ZZ plants work beside the balcony door and in the corners for several plants, though they come in nursery pots and would need ceramic pots like the embossed one in the catalog.
At 43 cm high and 140 cm wide, this wood-and-metal etagere sits low under the back window, with room for books and plants.
The carved wooden drum table is round and distinctly bohemian, and at 61 cm it suits the space in front of the sofa on the rug.
Its turned column and linen shade give a warm, relaxed look that suits the boho mix better than the chrome lamps.
The navy and cream geometric throw with fringe picks up the rug's blue and stands out against the cognac sofa.

answer.why: There was no mustard velvet sofa, so a cognac leather one stands in, with mustard brought in through the cushions; it anchors a palette of natural rattan and carved wood. The large blue-and-rust rug, colorful cushions, fringed throw and plenty of greenery layer on top for a lived-in, cheerful bohemian living room.
